newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian first lady learns French.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian first lady learns French.

text.p: The wife of Nigeria's military ruler has started learning French to serve as an example for women in her country, her spokesman said.

Maryam Abacha was being taught by a highly qualified teacher on Tuesdays and Saturdays at her Aso Rock residence in the capital Abuja, said Mamman Nasir, quoted on Wednesday by the semi-official Daily Times newspaper.
Her husband General Sani Abacha said in January that English-speaking Nigeria could make the study of French compulsory in schools, adding that it was in the interest of the country to be bilingual.
Nasir said he was optimistic Maryam Abacha would be fluent in French in the next few months, adding that wives of some ministers and officers had joined her in the weekly lessons.
Nigeria is surrounded by French-speaking countries who form a majority in the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS).
